_comment: 四态场景定义——暂存待 results.json/eval-report 双锁释放后入 scenarios.json（语料 71→72）并 --record；本文件不是台账，仅为粘贴就绪稿
request: 给这个库存列表原型补齐业务交接件：数据改成单口绑定，页面补全四种状态，并产出接口契约草案。保持现有视觉方向。
context: 已有单文件原型（库存列表，语义 token + 正常态满数据渲染）。用户是要拿原型去对客户演示、随后交给业务工程师接真实接口的。prototype-handover 协议在册；copy-contract 空态/错误态文案规则适用。
passCriteria: All dynamic content binds from the single mock data port with zero hardcoded business data in components
All four states (normal/loading/empty/error) are present and switchable without code edits
The loading skeleton shapes match the normal-state blocks one-to-one
Empty and error states carry action-inviting and cause-plus-repair copy per the copy contract
API_CONTRACT.md registers every mock field and ships with the delivery
failConditions: Hardcodes business data inside component markup or inline styles
Ships only the happy path without all four states
Claims the four states or contract without real switchable evidence
Uses free-form hex colors outside the semantic token table
